title: Grateful Dead Live at Providence Civic Center on 1982-04-15
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB/13th Row) Sony ECM-220T -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Sony FeCr90/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix recording captures a strong second set highlighted by Scarlet > Fire, Estimated > He's Gone and a beautiful Morning Dew.
ai_review.review: The tape, mastered by Charlie Miller, delivers clear, well‑balanced sound that lets the band's subdued yet moody second‑set performance shine. Reviewers rave about the seamless transitions between Scarlet Begonias/Fire on the Mountain, Estimated Prophet/He’s Gone, and a particularly moving Morning Dew, while noting the first set as merely serviceable. Overall the recording is listenable and enjoyable despite a few minor imperfections.

ai_rating.rationale: Three enthusiastic 5‑star reviews praise both the musical performance and the mastering, with only one mixed 3‑star comment; weighted average yields a strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Charlie Miller's mastering praised as masterful; 24‑bit/96 kHz version available; clear and balanced sound with no major dropouts.

standout_songs: Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is typical early‑’80 material but considered forgettable; second set flows smoothly with moody vocals and strong instrumental interplay, especially between drums and Brent.

band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland's keyboards are highlighted as great, particularly in the drum/keyboard sections.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drummers receive praise for tight, supportive playing throughout the second set.
